execution_gate: A verdict is issued only from the frozen executable evidence and is exactly PASS, FAIL, Unknown, or CONTRACT-GAP.
acceptance: PASS is allowed only when the row's observable was actually produced and resolved; a current-only PASS must be labelled as such and cannot satisfy an SVG-parity row.
rejection: A proved contradiction of an applicable obligation is FAIL.
unknown_or_gap_policy: Unknown means represented input but inconclusive observation; CONTRACT-GAP means absent public information or an explicit L0 rejection/scope-out. Neither is implicit success.
